title: Kagamine Len — In The Best Way Possible!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why did Emu seem so down then...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm happy and full of energy! See?
Like big old bear in the forest♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It really looked like she was forcing herself to smile.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought so too. Isn't there anything we can do for her...?

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: We want Emu to have a sparkly smile like always!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Emu always looks so happy and cheerful that her energy makes everyone else feel the same way too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah☆ That's also why it's always so much fun to do shows with her too♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. And when she's feeling down, it sort of brings down the mood for the whole place too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then we need to come up with a way to make Emu smile again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, but... How do we do that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, it looked like she was letting a lot of different things stay bottled up inside of her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right. She wants to talk about it but can't get herself to...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... And we might not be the ones that she should be talking to either.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Emu has Tsukasa and the others too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. But I don't want to not do anything...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Isn't there anything else we can do for her instead of talking?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't know... I can't think of anything!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: But we want to help her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (No... Everyone else is starting to feel the same way as her...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Times like these... KAITO and Miku would...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If we all start feeling down, then we definitely won't be able to come up with a way to cheer Emu up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We should start by cheering ourselves up!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah! We can't let ourselves get down like that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (More! Until our hearts feel like they're about to burst with joy!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, okay! We can dance too! Just gotta time it right and...)

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Hehehe! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I got it! What we can do for Emu!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We don't have to do anything difficult or complicated!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We just have to do what we're good at!
A show that can make her smile!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Emu loves shows too, so I'm sure we can make her smile with a performance!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll have to practice this alongside KAITO's show, so it might be a little tough...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But I want to do this!
I want to see Emu smile!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's start getting ready then!
